task.description: initial = 为新文档出第一层候选写作路线；expand = 为指定节点出下一层子路线。

roomId.description: Target room id injected by the gateway; binds provenance to the room.

documentId.description: The new document this route plan belongs to.

title.description: Document title as written by the user; also the route map root. Never rewritten.

description.description: Optional user requirement text from the conversation, context framing.

pathContext.description: expand task only: already selected route chain labels, root to target, ' > ' joined.

targetLabel.description: expand task only: the node label to deepen one more layer under.

material.description: Relation-board three-graph material assembled by the gateway: related rooms, entities, facts, documents and their links.

materialTruncated.description: True when the gateway truncated the assembled material to fit the budget.

responseLanguage.description: Preferred label language hint (e.g. a BCP-47 tag); fall back to the title's own language.
